name: io.github.DB-25/arc-control-mcp
title: Arc Control (macOS)
description: macOS-only MCP server for the Arc browser: tabs, navigation, page reading, DOM, scripting

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_SPACE
environmentVariables.description: The Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.
